Route 3 — ST185-A-engine (rev 3)

Rev 4 (2026‑10‑10): bigger main view, numbered key, one detail view (isometric + top) per branch / group. No wiring change. Previous version saved as ROUTE-3-A-ENGINE-rev4.html.

Rev 1 and rev 2 kept as ROUTE-3-A-ENGINE-rev1.html / -rev2.html. Rev 3 (Dan’s mark-up 2026‑10‑05): crank moved slightly to his “crank below” spot; the COP sub-loom enters at cylinder 4 (cam end) and runs 4→3→2→1; the injector branch follows the same 4→1 direction.

PLANNING ONLY — not committed. Best-fit path on a factory perspective drawing, not measured. Device list from sot/channels.csv (ECU connector A) — not from the old drawings. Bulkhead cavity numbers other than c33/c34 are PROVISIONAL (plan Section 12).
Status (Dan, 2026‑10‑14): APPROVED as drawn (rev 3). Drawing unchanged; no open markup on this route.
Layout rule (Dan’s preference, ENGINE-A-LAYOUT-PROPOSAL.html): one trunk from bulkhead A down the engine with branch points at measured spots, not one long run per device. Two fan points near the firewall (FP1, FP2), then the trunk continues ~450 mm to FP3. On-engine branch order follows Dave’s sketch; the firewall section is mirrored for LHD. Bulkheads A/B are on the passenger (RH) firewall, directly above the alternator (Route 1 rev 3).
